DataSource.query:
begin
SELECT 
srcc.COD_COMPANY as company, concat('AC', dd.SEQ_YEAR) as actuality, concat('C-', aa.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT) as account, sum(fsl.AMT_NET_ENTRY_SOURCE_COMP_CUR) as amount
  FROM [KUHN_BI_DWH].[ACCOUNTING].[FACT_SAVING_LEDGER] fsl
  left outer join common.DIM_COMPANY srcc on fsl.SEQ_SOURCE_COMPANY = srcc.SEQ_COMPANY
  left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_CODE ac on fsl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE = ac.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE
  left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_LOG al on fsl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG = al.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG
  left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT aa on fsl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT = aa.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT
  left outer join common.DIM_DAY dd on fsl.SEQ_ENTRY_DAY = dd.SEQ_DAY
  where srcc.COD_COMPANY = 'T'
  and ac.COD_ACCOUNTING_CODE = 'C'
  and al.COD_ACCOUNTING_LOG = 'RGT'
  and aa.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT in ('511210', '511220')
  /* Année courante */
  and ((dd.SEQ_DAY >= year((dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate()))) * 10000 + month((dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate()))) * 100
  + day((dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate())))
  and dd.SEQ_DAY <= year((dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))) * 10000 + month((dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))) * 100
  + day((dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))))
  /* Année N-1 */
  or (dd.SEQ_DAY >= year(dateadd(year, -1, dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate()))) * 10000 + month(dateadd(year, -1, dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate()))) * 100
  + day(dateadd(year, -1, dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate())))
  and dd.SEQ_DAY <= year(dateadd(year, -1, dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))) * 10000 + month(dateadd(year, -1, dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))) * 100
  + day(dateadd(year, -1, dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))))
    /* Année N-2 */
  or (dd.SEQ_DAY >= year(dateadd(year, -2, dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate()))) * 10000 + month(dateadd(year, -2, dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate()))) * 100
  + day(dateadd(year, -2, dateadd(day, ((day(getdate())-1)*-1), getdate())))
  and dd.SEQ_DAY <= year(dateadd(year, -2, dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))) * 10000 + month(dateadd(year, -2, dateadd(day, -1, getdate()))) * 100
  + day(dateadd(year, -2, dateadd(day, -1, getdate())))))
 group by srcc.COD_COMPANY, dd.SEQ_YEAR, aa.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT
 order by srcc.COD_COMPANY, dd.SEQ_YEAR, aa.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT
 end
